rationale: The last five 1-minute candles show a sharp, accelerating sell-off (from ~19.30 down to 19.08) with the final candle carrying nearly 4x the volume of the prior bars, suggesting active distribution rather than a clean setup. Price is sitting right at VWAP and the 9-EMA with no clear support or rejection level to anchor a stop, making risk definition imprecise. The broad market is under significant pressure (SPY -1.57%, VIXY +6.24%), and with no directional edge identifiable in the current structure, the risk/reward does not justify entry in either direction.
